title: Entropic gateway: histogram online mean-force estimator vs the accepted Gaussian-kernel estimator, ABF and ABF+FR
question: Replacing the online kernel estimator (h_bias 0.07, interpolated bias force) by the textbook ABF histogram (M_j/(C_j+1), own-bin bias force): (Q1) how does plain ABF's accuracy move with the bin width; (Q2) does uniform-FR's gain over ABF persist under the histogram estimator; (Q3) how does the histogram's NATIVE read-out compare with the frozen corrected read-out h_read* = 0.0175.
sampler: results/gateway_anchor/CONFIRMATORY_PREREGISTRATION.json (N 2048, dt 4e-4, 100k steps, T 40, eta 0.10, fr_every 10, ramp 0.10, min_count 1)
pairing: both arms in one batch per estimator (shared init + Langevin noise); every estimator batch uses the SAME batch_seed 61000 and the SAME row order, so ABF(hist) vs ABF(kernel) is paired on identical noise (the gateway bandwidth-audit convention)
primary_readout: e_F at h_read* = 0.0175 from the fine-grid raw accumulators, identical for every arm (Sf, C are deposited on the fine grid regardless of the online estimator); integrated I_F over t>0 and final e_F(T)
native_readout: the histogram arm's own bins: F'_j = M_j/C_j (visited bins), piecewise-constant on the fine grid, integrated and centred, RMS vs the analytic F on the evaluation window; for the kernel arm the legacy h = 0.07 read-out
statistics: paired median % change, 10000-resample bootstrap 95% CI, wins/32; FR health floors (min ancestor ESS/N >= 0.30, max lineage share <= 0.05) reported, not gating

predictions_recorded_before_running.P1_abf_fine_bins_hurt: hist_180 ABF I_F at h_read* is WORSE than kernel_0.07 by +10..+30 % (sharper online bandwidth hurt ABF +10.4 %/+14.9 % in docs/GATEWAY_CORRECTED_BASELINE.md; raw bins are sharper still)
predictions_recorded_before_running.P2_abf_coarse_bins_match: some bin width in 0.06..0.15 gives ABF I_F within +-5 % of kernel_0.07 (box sigma = width/sqrt(12) ~ 0.017..0.043 brackets the Gaussian 0.07's effective width once its 4-sigma support is considered)
predictions_recorded_before_running.P3_fr_gain_persists: fr_uniform beats abf at h_read* under EVERY histogram width, integrated <= -20 % and final <= -40 % with >= 28/32 wins (the corrected-baseline gain -31.9 %/-59.4 % is a dynamics effect, not a read-out effect)
predictions_recorded_before_running.P4_fr_gain_grows_with_sharpness: the FR relative gain is at least as large under hist_180 as under kernel_0.07 (a sharper estimator is more sensitive to uneven occupancy, which uniform-FR removes) -- low confidence
predictions_recorded_before_running.P5_native_vs_corrected: for bins <= 0.06 the native read-out is within 10 % of the h_read* read-out (raw bins were on the read-out plateau, 0.00538 vs 0.00528); for bins >= 0.10 the native read-out is worse by discretisation of the s = 0.1 gateway feature

not_run: frozen-bias stage (estimator-independent endpoint) omitted from this exploratory design; can be added
